p.espaces.rg_d: International standards, product standards, start-up business, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the latest official sources, and then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Guide (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for product and country, customs, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): Customs Duties and Rules of Origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labels and health regulations that this country applies to products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs code and duty on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a Business, Taxes, International Trade, Countries
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that the platform has not been marked by a regulator before trusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: The site will open in his native language: use your browser's translation or "Document Understanding" for the document. Ask a specialist in your country for important decisions.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: A guide to buying and selling between countries. 24/24 ONE WORLD does not make customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UNWTO): Duties and Rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): Customs, Taxes, Rules of Origin, Step by Step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs Code (HS Code) and Duty on Entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (EU importing or exporting companies)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller passes the export-cleared goods to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; after that risks and costs pass to the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays freight and insurance to port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. These lists will be rejected and can be reported.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly… compare the rates for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything on these links: you compare them here and then send them using the service you choose.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Money transfer prices worldwide (World Bank): real cost of money transfer, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash receipt in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash receipt, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, cost will be shown before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash receipt
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash receipt
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total amount received: fee + exchange rate. The rate that is lower than the market is the hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person will receive it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN …).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An identification document is often required for both sending and receiving.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online, or to "unlock" a prize, parcel, credit, or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check their website when you send.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that a supplier ships directly to your customer. It's easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers' country: no counterfeit, no regulated product without a license.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ('Wholesale / Supplier' here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, buyer's country VAT, payments and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the real delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade Rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting consumer rights: clear prices, including taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A vendor who wants to receive full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: banned and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a parcel from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
